title: PAARA Connector Audit Kit
description: An open, practitioner toolkit for auditing AI connectors before they are enabled in an enterprise. PAARA (Privacy-Aware AI Risk Architecture) treats the connector — OAuth/API permissions, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and retrieval pipelines — as the unit of governance, and scores it with an explicit, reproducible seven-factor rule (F1–F7) that yields a deployment decision. The kit ships a 20-test Python scanner (standard library only), a coded audit of 13 public connectors from documentation retrieved 9 November 2026 (9 of 13 Critical on the lower bound, 12 of 13 on the upper bound, none Low), a connector audit checklist, and a connector DPIA template.
